feature_descriptions.lag_1: Bill of the previous month (t-1), kWh
feature_descriptions.lag_12: Bill of the same billing month last year (t-12), kWh — captures seasonality
feature_descriptions.roll_mean_3: Mean of the bills t-3..t-1 (observed months only), kWh
feature_descriptions.roll_mean_6: Mean of the bills t-6..t-1, kWh
feature_descriptions.roll_median_3: Median of the bills t-3..t-1 — robust to a single spike, kWh
feature_descriptions.roll_std_6: Standard deviation of the bills t-6..t-1 — how stable the household is, kWh
feature_descriptions.hist_mean: Mean of ALL earlier bills (expanding, up to t-1), kWh — long-run level
feature_descriptions.hist_max: Highest earlier bill (up to t-1), kWh
feature_descriptions.change_1: lag_1 - lag_2: most recent month-to-month change, kWh
feature_descriptions.zero_count_6: Number of zero bills among t-6..t-1
feature_descriptions.missing_count_6: Number of missing bills among t-6..t-1
feature_descriptions.month_of_year: Calendar month of the billing month (1-12)
feature_descriptions.month_sin: sin(2*pi*month/12) — cyclic month encoding (Dec is next to Jan)

prediction_task: one-month-ahead bill of a known household (billing month t, using bills up to t-1)
selection_rule: lowest mean validation MAE over the 5 expanding folds (experiment 'tuned')

model_selection.rule: lowest mean validation MAE over the 5 expanding folds (experiment 'tuned')

dataset.name: RECON-SL (Residential Electricity Consumption Dataset for Sri Lanka)
dataset.scope: Households in LECO service areas along Sri Lanka's western/south-western coast
